sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Agency for Equities, CFDs and Derivative Instruments

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Westminster-style common law statutory framework with French civil law inheritance; unitary national corporate and securities regulation administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: China-Vanuatu Agreement on the Promotion and Protection of Investments (signed 27 April 2011; in force)
PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus; in force 13 December 2020)
WTO membership (acceded 24 August 2012); no comprehensive double taxation agreements in force

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2023 (Act No. 14 of 2023), administered by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit and the VFSC as AML/CFT supervisors for securities dealers; Dealers in Securities Act [Cap. 64] as amended by the Dealing in Securities (Amendment) Act 2017; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [Cap. 275]; International Companies Act [Cap. 222], ss. 26-29 and s. 122 (registers and record-keeping); United Nations Act [Cap. 186] for sanctions implementation.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — Beneficial ownership records are maintained by the licensed registered agent and retained on site in Vanuatu; the register of members is accessible to the VFSC and the VFIU upon demand but is not a public registry; corporate and nominee shareholding structures remain permissible only where full disclosure of the ultimate beneficial owner is made to the registered agent.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of the constitutional documents (certificate of incorporation and memorandum/articles of association) of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of Companies of the corporate shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Vanuatu party to the Apostille Convention since 16 March 2022; for documents originating from non-contracting states, consular legalization through the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs is required)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Attested copy of passport or government-issued identity document of each proposed director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner (English or French translation required if issued in non-Latin script)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority or issuing government office of the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization depending on the state of issuance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or incumbency for each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry of the foreign jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization depending on the state of issuance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original or notarized bank reference letter addressed to the VFSC-licensed registered agent for each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial bank maintaining the UBO's principal account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Banker's notarized attestation plus Hague Apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance certificate (criminal record extract) for each director and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police or ministry of justice of each country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization depending on the state of issuance

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of every director, shareholder, UBO and authorized signatory against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, UN Security Council Consolidated List, UK HM Treasury Consolidated List, EU consolidated financial sanctions list and Vanuatu domestic measures under the United Nations Act [Cap. 186]. PEP identification covers heads of state and government, senior politicians, senior judicial and military officers, senior officials of state-owned enterprises, and heads of international organizations, with enhanced due diligence on family members and close associates under sections 53-58 of the AML/CFT Act 2023 and FATF Recommendations 12 and 22. Adverse media and negative news checks are mandatory, and the fit-and-proper determination must be documented in the registered agent's client acceptance file.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry — name search and reservation service, Port Vila (submissions by licensed registered agents through the VFSC Registry e-services portal, vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must use the 26-letter Latin alphabet in English or French orthography; English and French are the official languages; names in non-Latin scripts are unavailable and must be transliterated into Latin characters; the corporate suffix must appear as 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Société Anonyme' or 'SA' as the last word.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banker, Banking, Building Society, Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance, Trust, Trustee, Co-operative, Chamber of Commerce (restricted; VFSC approval or a separate sectoral license required)
Government, Crown, Ministry, Imperial, National, Reserve, State, Municipal, Council (prohibited — implies state patronage or sovereign affiliation)
Incorporated, Corporation, Inc, Corp (not permitted as statutory suffixes for Vanuatu International Companies)
VFSC, Financial Services Authority, or terms implying a stock exchange listing or affiliation (prohibited absent prior VFSC authorization)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Registrar rejects a proposed name, the licensed registered agent files a written reconsideration request with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of rejection, enclosing three alternative names in priority order; a refusal does not extinguish the right to lodge a fresh reservation. An applicant aggrieved by a final refusal may petition the Supreme Court of Vanuatu for judicial review under the International Companies Act within 21 days of the final written refusal. No separate administrative fee is imposed for reconsideration, but any new reservation is subject to the standard search fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible for administrative coordination only; the International Company must at all times maintain a physical registered office in Port Vila or another prescribed location supplied by the VFSC-licensed registered agent under section 34 of the International Companies Act. For the offshore securities brokerage license under the Dealers in Securities Act, a physical, staffed Vanuatu office with a responsible director, designated compliance officer and accessible records is mandatory; remote-only operations will not satisfy the fit-and-proper licensing test. The overseas sales desk may operate remotely under supervision.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High — the VFSC conducts risk-based on-site examinations under the AML/CFT Act 2023; for a High-Risk retail securities brokerage (ISIC 6611), the probability of at least one announced or unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months is assessed at approximately 85%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC company name search and name reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: VFSC published fee schedule for International Companies

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC incorporation filing fee (Certificate of Incorporation, memorandum and articles of association)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: VFSC statutory tariff for International Company incorporation issued under the International Companies Act

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC filing fee for registered office and registered agent notification (Form 3 lodgements)
Licensed registered agent service — first annual engagement (includes registered office in Port Vila and UBO record maintenance)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for Vanuatu International Company administration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of constitutional documents and identity documents in the country of origin (bundle for 3 directors/UBOs)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in each country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff of the country of origin (market estimate)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille certification or consular legalization of the notarized bundle (5 documents, multiple origin states)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority / Vanuatu consular post or Ministry of Foreign Affairs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee per apostille or consular service (estimated per document)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Police clearance certificates (criminal record extracts) for each director and UBO (3 persons)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: National police or ministry of justice of the relevant states
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official fee schedule of each issuing state

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank reference letters and bankers' attestations (3 UBOs)
UBO piercing and corporate KYC verification performed by the registered agent (source-of-funds and source-of-wealth review)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for enhanced due diligence in a High-Risk AML category

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening — initial screening and monitoring subscription for 12 months (OFAC, UN, UK, EU and domestic lists)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for an entity with 3 named persons and ongoing monitoring

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of bespoke memorandum and articles of association tailored to ISIC 6611 (retail securities brokerage, CFD and derivatives agency)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed legal fee under prevailing Port Vila market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation fit-and-proper and licensing-readiness assessment (Dealers in Securities Act pre-application review for the future VFSC license)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu external counsel / licensed compliance consultant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed advisory fee under prevailing market benchmark

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (ss. 6-14: incorporation by registration, constitution, registered office, registered agent) read together with the Companies Act [Cap. 191] and the Financial Dealers Act [Cap. 245] for regulated dealing activity.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies and International Companies Registry, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 Application for Registration of an International Company culminating in the Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement under Cap. 222 for an International Company; nominal authorized capital (standard US$ 50,000) with at least one issued share at par. However, the VFSC Financial Dealer Licence requires a minimum operational net worth (typically not less than VUV 5,000,000 or US$ equivalent), evidenced by an audited capital declaration before trading.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: 1. The subscribers hereby subscribe to the authorized and issued share capital of the Company, and the allotment of shares at par to the founding members as recorded in the Register of Members is duly approved. 2. The premises situated in Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu, nominated by the licensed registered agent, are hereby adopted as the statutory registered office of the Company. 3. The persons named in the appointment schedule are unanimously appointed as the first directors and company secretary, each consenting to act and serve until the next annual meeting. 4. The directors are expressly authorized to execute all statutory filings, retain legal counsel, and liaise with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission on all incorporation and licensing matters.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry - Name Clearance Desk (physical counter or VFSC e-registry portal), Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed corporate name to the VFSC name clearance desk or via the electronic registry. The name must end with the 'International Company' or 'IC' suffix and must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered name. Pay the name search fee and obtain a dated name reservation receipt valid for 90 days.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is declined or queried, select a revised name and re-file promptly; the initial reservation fee is non-refundable, but a waiver may be requested for typographical corrections submitted within 7 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Agent Engagement and Constitutional Documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent firms in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a VFSC-licensed registered agent who will supply the statutory registered office and act as the local nexus. Execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the standard International Company form, confirm the authorized capital structure, and obtain the agent's executed consent to act as registered agent and registered office provider.
required_dossiers: Shareholder and beneficial owner KYC records
Consent to act as registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Renegotiate the agent mandate if the consent is defective or the office address is rejected; correct and re-execute the constitutional documents with fresh witness signatures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry - Filing Section, Port Vila / e-submission portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 together with the executed constitution, subscriber declarations, and officer particulars with the VFSC Companies Registry either physically or electronically. Settle the statutory incorporation fee of US$ 250 by bank transfer or card. The Registrar examines the dossier for compliance with the International Companies Act Cap. 222.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition or query, respond in writing within 30 days with corrected documentation; upon failure, the application lapses and fees may be refunded less an administrative charge.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registrar of International Companies, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, collect the Certificate of Incorporation and company number from the VFSC. Verify the registered particulars as they appear in the public register and request rectification of any typographical omissions before filing the certificate in the corporate records.
required_dossiers: Extract from the International Companies Register
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File a rectification request with supporting evidence; the Registrar may reissue the certificate upon payment of a nominal correction fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolutions and Establishment of Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: First Board of Directors and Company Secretary (corporate governance function)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first meeting of the directors, adopt the pro-forma first board resolution, issue share certificates against the subscribed capital, and open the statutory registers covering members, directors, secretary, and charges. Arrange the common seal if required by the constitution.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any procedural omission may be ratified by a subsequent written resolution signed by all directors; late establishment of registers is cured by contemporaneous entries certified by the company secretary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Licensing Division; Department of Labour; Vanuatu National Provident Fund
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before commencing the securities brokerage business, file the Financial Dealer Licence application with the VFSC Licensing Division under the Financial Dealers Act Cap. 245, submit the AML/CFT compliance manual under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2016, and register as an employer with the Department of Labour and the Vanuatu National Provident Fund.
required_dossiers: Biographical and police clearance forms for directors
Audited bank reference or net worth evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the licensing application is queried, submit supplemental disclosure within 20 working days; unresolved deficiencies may be escalated to the VFSC internal appeals committee or remedied by engaging a licensed compliance consultant.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Licensing Division, Port Vila; Department of Labour for workplace and occupational registration
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Financial Dealer's Licence (Class 2 - Securities Broker and Retail Derivative Dealing) under the Financial Dealers Act [Cap. 245], issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Port Vila
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category 4 office-based financial services; no full EIA or preliminary environmental report required. A building permit environmental clearance is required for the registered office fit-out; any standby generator installation triggers a low-impact environmental registration.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or volatile organic compound generation; domestic sanitary effluent must meet Port Vila municipal sewer discharge limits. Any standby diesel generator must comply with DEPC ambient air quality guidelines for PM10 and SO2 and with applicable noise limits; all waste electrical and electronic equipment must be handled through an authorized DEPC-licensed e-waste disposal contractor.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Services prior to business occupancy; structural load endorsement issued by the Public Works Department on the building permit for the registered office; workplace registration and occupational health and safety clearance obtained from the Department of Labour under the Health and Safety at Work Act 2018.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA) — the national competent authority for value added tax, excise, and customs; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) is the licensing and corporate registry authority for International Companies (ICs). The VRCA operates the VAT registration and return portal; the VFSC maintains the IC register under the International Companies Act Cap. 222.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax; a Vanuatu International Company does not obtain an income-tax TIN. The statutory tax identity for an IC is the VFSC International Company registration number issued at incorporation. Where the entity makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu exceeding VT 10,000,000 in any 12-month rolling period, it must apply to the VRCA for a VAT Registration Number (VRN) using Form VAT-01, accompanied by the VFSC certificate of incorporation, constitutional documents, registered office consent, director identification, and the proposed effective date of registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — the International Companies Act Cap. 222 confers complete statutory tax exemption from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, dividends, interest, royalties, estate duty, gift duty, and stamp duty. The only recurring fiscal charges are the VFSC annual license fee and government registration fees.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, pass-through, or hybrid mismatch election mechanism exists because Vanuatu has no income tax law and no controlled-foreign-company or transfer-pricing legislation. The sole significant election is voluntary VAT registration for an entity below the VT 10,000,000 threshold; once registered, the entity must remain registered for a minimum of two years unless deregistration criteria are lawfully met. There are no treaty election procedures as Vanuatu has no double tax agreements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 10,000,000 (ten million Vatu) of annual taxable turnover in the current or preceding 12-month period, approximating USD 84,000 at prevailing exchange rates.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance mandate, digital stamping, or state-run e-invoicing API is currently imposed by the VRCA. Taxable persons must issue prescribed VAT invoices disclosing the VRN, sequential invoice number, date, supplier and customer details, description, VAT-exclusive and inclusive amounts, and the VAT charged in Vatu. A simplified invoice is permitted for retail supplies below VT 2,500. Import procedures and customs documentation are processed through the ASYCUDA World electronic customs system, but domestic VAT issuance is not subject to live electronic clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the Value Added Tax Act 2014, exported services are zero-rated. An offshore securities brokerage is eligible for 0% VAT where: (i) the brokerage, execution, and CFD/spread services are contractually supplied to a non-resident client; (ii) the services are wholly performed and consumed outside Vanuatu; (iii) consideration is received from the client's offshore account in a foreign currency or into a segregated client wire account; and (iv) the IC holds contemporaneous documentary evidence of the export nature of the supply. Pure offshore-to-offshore brokerage income therefore falls outside Vanuatu's 12.5% VAT net and carries full input-credit recovery eligibility.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: VFSC International Company certificate of incorporation and valid annual license
Executed securities brokerage or services agreement identifying the non-resident client and their jurisdiction of tax residence
VAT invoice annotated 'Zero-Rated Export Services' bearing the valid VRN
SWIFT MT103, client wire instruction, or bank statement evidencing inward remittance of commission from a foreign bank account
Certified KYC file, including client passport, tax residence certificate, or equivalent government-issued non-resident identification
Trading platform ledger extract and trade tickets matching the invoice amounts and remittance records
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The VRCA may audit zero-rating claims for up to five years from the end of the VAT period and may recharacterize supplies as taxable at 12.5% where export evidence is incomplete, leading to retrospective clawback of the full output VAT. Civil penalties include an initial 5% late-payment penalty on the assessed tax plus 2% monthly interest on arrears; fraudulent zero-rating claims attract a civil penalty up to 200% of the tax evaded and criminal fines up to VT 5,000,000 and/or imprisonment of up to three years. Company directors are jointly and severally liable where the offense was committed with their knowledge or consent.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), Port Vila — sole monetary authority, issuer of the Vatu and prudential supervisor of licensed banks; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) concurrently administers the securities-dealer license for the brokerage. Vanuatu has no exchange-control certification or permit regime, and the RBV does not pre-authorize cross-border payments.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu is fully convertible on both current and capital accounts in line with Vanuatu's IMF Article VIII obligations. There are no approval, registration, tax or waiting-period hurdles on repatriation of dividends, trading profits, capital, or shareholder-loan repayments by a licensed International Company. The practical constraint is market microstructure: the offshore VUV market is thin, so the brokerage should denominate clearing and treasury liquidity in USD, AUD and NZD multi-currency accounts, using VUV only for domestic operating expenses. Banks may apply internal reasonableness checks and request a board resolution for large outward remittances, but no statutory profit-remittance restriction exists.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Vanuatu imposes no statutory surrender timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio and no retention limit for export proceeds, brokerage commissions, service fees, or settlement receipts. The VU_IC may lawfully retain 100% of revenues in foreign-currency accounts indefinitely without RBV notification or conversion obligation.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (client-money trust) plus Operational Multi-Currency USD/AUD/VUV Account
Operational Multi-Currency Account with USD correspondent clearing
Operational Account with segregated client ledger

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Vanuatu has no domestic Electronic Money Institution (EMI) charter; the VFSC does not issue EMI, sandbox or e-money licenses, and the Financial Dealers Act does not recognize foreign EMIs as custodians of client money. EU/UK or Asia-Pacific licensed EMIs will in practice decline a Vanuatu offshore high-risk retail derivatives broker as a treasury client without substantiated local licensing and substance. Foreign EMI and money-transfer rails may be used only as limited-cap settlement-extraction channels for client payouts, never as the primary custody or liquidity platform.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person onboarding is effectively mandatory for a high-risk offshore securities broker. Although a remote pre-screening call is permitted, each director and beneficial owner — or a professional-nominee representative holding a notarized power of attorney — must attend a face-to-face KYC interview at the bank's Port Vila head office. The interview covers UBO verification, source of wealth, projected monthly transaction volumes, client geographic footprint, use of Visa/Mastercard rails and client-money segregation mechanics. Onboarding typically completes in 7–15 business days after the physical interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company with non-resident directors, nominee shareholders and a multi-layered trust/UBO chain masking ultimate ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registry-certified Certificate of Incorporation, current directors/members register and no-bearer-shares declaration; complete UBO chart with passports, proof-of-address and source-of-wealth records; regulated registered-agent attestation letter; VFSC securities-dealer license certificate; constitutional documents and board resolutions certified by the Vanuatu International Companies registry.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk product profile — retail CFDs, leveraged derivatives and margin trading funded via Visa/Mastercard — creating elevated consumer-harm, chargeback and cross-jurisdictional regulatory-claims exposure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Client-money trust deed appointing the tier-1 bank as trustee of segregated funds; Vanuatu legal opinion confirming segregation compliance under the Financial Dealers Act Cap¬†; audited financial statements or auditor's comfort letter for the most recent two years; documented chargeback-management and refund policy; principal-membership or acquiring-sponsor agreement for card rails; clean disciplinary-history letter from the VFSC; AML/CFT policy manual and named compliance officer with CRC/CFA qualification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High expected transaction velocity with broad geographic client reach, including possible exposure to sanctioned, high-risk or unregulated jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Production-grade transaction-monitoring and sanctions-screening configuration (OFAC/EU/UN coverage) demonstrated at onboarding; geo-blocking and prohibited-country policy; independent third-party AML audit report or evidence of a dedicated AML officer; payment-processor agreements showing downstream KYC obligations; typology study confirming prohibition of unregulated third-party funding, cash couriers and wallet-hopping.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient provenance and quantum of initial working capital intended for the operational deposit and share-capital funding.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution authorizing the capital injection and account opening; bank statements and investment records covering the UBO's accumulated net worth; completed investor-source questionnaire tabulating private wealth; reference letter from an independent corporate service provider; tax-exemption or tax-clearance certificate issued by the Vanuatu Department of Finance confirming no outstanding liabilities.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Execute as SWIFT MT103 from the contributing shareholder's or beneficial owner's bank account to the VU_IC operational account. Because Vanuatu is exchange-control-free, no RBV approval or import permit is required; the remittance narrative (field 70) must state 'CAPITAL INJECTION / SHARE ALLOTMENT — NO COMMERCIAL INVOICE' and cite the VU_IC corporate name and account number. Where the originating bank mandates an ISO 20022 purpose code, 'INVE' (Investment) is generally appropriate. The receiving Vanuatu bank conducts sanctions screening and source-of-funds verification; the onboarding dossier must contain the board resolution approving the account and an attestation that the funds represent equity or shareholder loan, not client money or third-party proceeds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Retail client withdrawals and counterparty settlements execute via SWIFT MT103, with bank-to-bank treasury and NOSTRO repositioning via SWIFT MT202 COV. USD clearing is performed through correspondent lines typically held at ANZ New York or Bank of South Pacific's US correspondent. Visa/Mastercard settlements flow from the acquiring sponsor into the operational account on T+1/T+2 cycles. Commercial Letters of Credit (MT700) are admissible only for institutional peer-to-peer collateral arrangements and are not used for retail payouts; the standard disposition method is a segregated MT103 wire carrying the client name and broker reference in field 70, subject to the bank's sanctions and velocity filters.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable Outright FX Forwards (VUV/USD, VUV/AUD, VUV/NZD) up to 12 months tenor with a Vanuatu licensed tier-1 bank
Vanuatu-Vatu Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) with USD settlement, used where offshore VUV deliverability is unavailable
Cross-Currency Swaps (CCS) converting surplus VUV or NZD cash flows into the brokerage's operating USD liquidity
Short-dated FX Swaps for rolling treasury positions and managing client-money currency mismatches
Vanilla OTC FX Options (USD/VUV calls and puts) executed with the domestic treasury desk for downside protection on receivable currencies

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on or before 60 days following the incorporation anniversary; calendar-year filers must submit by 31 August
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VUV 5,000 (approx. USD 42) per month or part thereof; persistent default beyond 6 months triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the incorporation anniversary date; 90-day statutory grace period applies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment within grace period triggers 50% surcharge; continued default results in strike-off and forfeiture of all corporate assets to the Government of Vanuatu

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Dealers in Securities Licence Annual Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal application and fee due on or before 31 December of each year; licence runs on a calendar-year basis
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs a 25% surcharge on the licence fee; lapse beyond 3 months triggers automatic suspension; unlicensed brokerage activity is a criminal offence under the Dealers in Securities Act Cap 70

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Compliance Return with Audited Financial Statements (Licensed Dealer)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days of the financial year end (31 December for calendar-year filers); auditor's report must accompany the filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing triggers licence suspension and referral to the Attorney General for prosecution; persistent default leads to licence cancellation and disqualification of directors

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for all holders of a Dealers in Securities Licence irrespective of turnover; unlicensed International Companies are audit-exempt unless annual turnover exceeds VUV 1,000,000 (approx. USD 8,500) or the company carries on banking, insurance or trust business
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by the Vanuatu Institute of Chartered Accountants for all licensed securities dealers; unlicensed International Companies may prepare accounts under simplified record-keeping standards per International Companies Act Cap 222

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must file an annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation with VFSC within 30 days of the company's incorporation anniversary; any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership during the year must be reported to VFSC within 14 days thereof

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies are fully exempt from Vanuatu income tax. No corporate tax, no capital gains tax, no undistributed profits tax, no stamp duty on offshore transactions and no exchange control. The only recurring imposts are the annual business license fee and the VFSC annual registration fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IC Annual Return (Section 165, International Companies Act, Cap. 222) filed electronically through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission VFSC e-Registry portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 28 days after the anniversary of incorporation, unless the constitutional documents prescribe an earlier date; submission and payment are processed by the registered agent

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered name of the International Company
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact name as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation; non-resident owners may use a Romanized name for filing.
Enter the VFSC registration number. Non-resident filers should quote the IC number on all correspondence to avoid misapplication of fees.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Date of incorporation and current registered office address
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the address of the registered agent in Vanuatu; a foreign street address is not acceptable for this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors, secretary and their residential addresses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List all directors regardless of residence. For non-resident directors, provide nationality, passport number and a service address for legal service.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital, and shareholder breakdown
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare bearer shares and nominee arrangements, if any. Non-resident beneficial owners must append an enforceable declaration to enable AML/CFT screening.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VFSC securities dealer license number and permitted scope of retail securities brokerage
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An International Company performing ISIC 6611 brokerage activity must hold a valid license under the Securities Dealers Act and must state the license reference; non-resident licensees must confirm the principal place of business abroad only if permitted.
Confirm that the company is not subject to Vanuatu income tax by virtue of section 128 of the International Companies Act; do not include foreign tax identification data in this box.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late submission of the IC Annual Return attracts a VUV 5,000 late filing fee and a potential VUV 1,000 per day surcharge for continued default. Persistent non-filing results in the company being struck off the International Companies Register, loss of limited liability status, and mandatory dissolution. The registered agent may also be fined for failing to secure timely compliance.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network applicable to International Companies. No treaty relief is necessary or administratively available. A non-resident shareholder requesting a lower withholding rate merely submits a Corporate Tax Residence Certificate issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; however, the statutory dividend withholding tax rate is already zero and the certificate does not create a separate exemption.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate 0% for cross-border royalties and debt interest. There is no domestic withholding tax on interest, royalties, management fees or technical service fees paid by an International Company. No treaty override applies because the domestic rate is already nil.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: N/A - Vanuatu has no transfer pricing legislation imposing Local File or Master File requirements. A statutory audit threshold of VUV 30,000,000 turnover or VUV 10,000,000 assets applies for financial statement filing, but this audit threshold does not create a transfer pricing documentation duty.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act and the Economic Substance Regulations apply to International Companies carrying on relevant activities. For a retail securities brokerage, the activity is assessed under the categories of 'financing and leasing' or 'distribution and service centre'. The company must demonstrate that core income-generating activities, board meetings and management decisions are conducted in Vanuatu. Merely being tax-exempt does not remove the economic substance filing obligation; annual ESR declarations must be filed with the VFSC regardless of zero corporate tax.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a passive shell with no Vanuatu board meeting, staff, local expenditure or business decision-making, while relying on the IC's tax exemption and claiming modern form of tax avoidance; or filing a materially false Economic Substance declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Cancellation of the International Company registration; penalty up to VUV 10,000,000 under the Economic Substance Regulations; criminal prosecution for false declarations under the Penal Code with imprisonment up to 2 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution to affected shareholders and creditors. The court may pierce the corporate veil, issue travel bans, order asset freezing, and impose personal imprisonment for directors found to have orchestrated phantom substance and tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Carrying out retail equities, CFDs or derivative order-negotiation, client money custody, margin trading or issuance of investment advice to non-resident clients without a valid VFSC Overseas Securities Dealer license and without a segregated client money trust account.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Cease-and-desist order; criminal fine up to VUV 5,000,000; revocation of the company's IC status; nullity of all client-facing brokerage agreements entered into while unlicensed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for customer losses through court-ordered restitution; the VFSC has power to disqualify directors for up to 5 years; travel prohibitions and imprisonment up to 3 years may be imposed under the Securities Dealers Act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting wire transfers or card deposits from third parties without obtaining beneficial ownership information, failing to perform ongoing CDD, neglecting suspicious transaction report filing, or allowing nominee shareholding to conceal economic substance; exploitation of the high-risk securities brokerage channel.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Liability under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act; regulatory fines up to VUV 20,000,000; license suspension; detailed adverse findings in FATF and APG evaluations; criminal confiscation of proceeds and imprisonment for money laundering up to 10 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the appointed compliance officer face personal fines, criminal money-laundering convictions, confiscation of gains, travel bans, and imprisonment. The corporate veil will be pierced where nominee arrangements are used to hide the beneficial owner.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False tax residence certificate and international misrepresentation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Obtaining a VFSC residence certificate or tax residency letter while the entire board meeting, client solicitation and risk management occur outside Vanuatu, and then presenting that certificate to foreign tax authorities or banking counterparties as evidence of genuine tax-resident status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fraud under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act; certificate revoked with immediate effect; penalty up to VUV 1,000,000; notification of the offence to foreign regulators and law enforcement agencies.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face civil restitution in favour of deceived financial institutions and investors, judicial travel bans, a personal director disqualification order, and imprisonment for fraud where the misrepresentation induced third-party reliance.
